parts.explain: Kelasi zamonda majburiyat haqida so'rash uchun «Will... have to» ishlatiladi.

wrong.Visitors don't have to feed the wild ani: Bu ularni shunchaki boqish majburiy emasligini bildiradi, lekin bu qat'iy taqiq.

wrong.Had you to wait a long time?: O'tgan zamonda savol berish uchun «Did... have to» ishlatiladi.

parts.answer: You don't have to wear a tie to the party.

intro.what: Biz bu modal fe'llardan majburiyat, taqiq va zarurat yo'qligini bildirish uchun foydalanamiz. Ular kundalik hayotda qoidalarni tushuntirish va maslahat berishda juda muhimdir.
when: Maktab yoki uy qoidalarini muhokama qilish

structures.label: Mustn't (Taqiq)
structures.example_en: You mustn't use your phone in class.

structures.label: Don't have to (Zarurat yo'q)
structures.example_en: I don't have to wear a uniform on Sunday.
structures.example_uz: Men yakshanba kuni forma kiyishim shart emas.

structures.label: Needn't (Kerak emas)
structures.example_en: You needn't bring an umbrella today.
structures.example_uz: Bugun soyabon olib kelishingiz shart emas.

rules.title: Must qoidasi
rules.text: Gapiruvchining shaxsiy fikriga ko'ra bajarilishi shart bo'lgan ishlar uchun ishlatiladi.

examples.en: We must arrive at school on time.
examples.uz: Biz maktabga o'z vaqtida kelishimiz shart.

rules.title: Mustn't taqiqi
rules.text: Biror ishni qilish qat'iyan taqiqlanganini bildiradi. Ma'nosi 'mumkin emas' deganidir.

examples.en: Students mustn't run in the corridor.

rules.title: Don't have to va Needn't
rules.text: Bu so'zlar harakatning majburiy emasligini, xohlasangiz qilishingiz mumkinligini bildiradi.

examples.en: You don't have to cook dinner tonight.
examples.uz: Bugun kechki ovqatni pishirishingiz shart emas.

examples.en: He needn't buy a new ticket.
examples.uz: U yangi chipta sotib olishi shart emas.

mistakes.why: Must so'zidan keyin 'to' ishlatilmaydi, fe'l o'z holatida keladi.
Present Simple zamirida inkor uchun 'doesn't have to' ishlatiladi.
